items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the penal law, in relation to enacting the "domestic violence escalation prevention act"
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5432

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the penal law, in relation to enacting
the "domestic violence escalation prevention act"

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL: This bill would improve public safety
and prevent domestic violence incidents from escalating into even
greater violence by keeping guns out of the hands of domestic violence
perpetrators.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1 titles the bill the "domestic violence escalation prevention
act". Section 2 amends subdivision 17 of section 265.00 of the Penal
Law, which defines the term "serious offense, by adding a new
paragraph c to include a crime set forth in subdivision 1 of section
530.11 of the criminal procedure law  where the victim of such offense
was a family or household member as defined in that section.  The term
"serious offense" is used in Penal Law section 400.00(1)(c) with
respect to eligibility for a license to carry, possess, repair and
dispose of firearms. Section 3 provides for the act to take effect
immediately.

JUSTIFICATION: A firearm in the hands of any criminal is a threat, and
this is especially true if it is in the hands of a domestic abuser.
Fifty-four percent of female homicides are committed with a firearm
and two thirds of all women killed with firearms are killed by their
male partners, By prohibiting domestic violence perpetrators from
lawfully possessing a firearm, this legislation will protect women and
limit the number of domestic violence incidences which escalate to
fetal consequences through the use of a gun.

PRIOR. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:  A.4489.A (passed Assembly 2011 and 2012);
A.7575 (passed Assembly 2009 and 2010).

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS: None.

EFFECTIVE DATE: This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Enacts the domestic violence escalation prevention act including certain offenses against members of the same family or household within the definition of serious offense for the purposes of firearms and other dangerous weapons.
title: Enacts the domestic violence escalation prevention act
